properties.displayName: UAV S8 - DShot/ESC Motor Manipulation (Autopilot Mixer Bypass)
properties.description: UAVActuator_CL에서 CommandSource가 autopilot_mixer가 아니거나 BypassAutopilot=true인 DShot/ESC 모터 명령 탐지. 공격자가 비행제어기의 믹서 로직을 우회해 개별 모터에 직접 out-of-band 명령을 주입, 특정 모터 지속 장악/추력 조작을 시도하는 정황. MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0855 / EMB3D 비인가명령주입
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
UAVActuator_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| extend isBypass = BypassAutopilot == true or CommandSource != 'autopilot_mixer'
| where isBypass
| summarize
    EventCount = count(),
    DistinctMotors = dcount(MotorId),
    MaxCommandValue = max(CommandValue),
    MinCommandValue = min(CommandValue),
    SourceSet = make_set(CommandSource)
    by UAVId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| where EventCount > 0
| extend TriggerReason = strcat('DShot_ESC_비인가_직접명령_', tostring(DistinctMotors), '개모터_', tostring(EventCount), '건')
| extend Severity = 'High'
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, EventCount, DistinctMotors, MaxCommandValue, MinCommandValue, SourceSet, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S8 - DShot/ESC Motor Manipulation (Autopilot Mixer Bypass) - {{UAVId}}
